profile.name: inets-foundation
profile.explanation: Foundation build/inventory/axiom gate and its seeded differential replay; omits the M3/Aeneas consumer build because its checked-in Aeneas cache trace is for a different build context and rebuilding Aeneas is forbidden.

pre_update_plan.evaluator: native data-only Lakefile parser; no Lakefile or package code executed
limitations: Dynamic Lean lakefile declarations and dependencies introduced only by a newly resolved upstream package cannot be predicted by the static pre-update plan.
After the approved source diff, Lake resolution is run in the disposable proposal worktree and its complete manifest is compared exactly with this prediction.

policy.adapters: native implementation; paranoid-lake-update and hopscotch are not used
policy.localization: native monotone bisection plus a complete linear scan; bisection assumes a good start and monotonic outcomes
